plugins.name: TLS Loopback HTTP
plugins.description: Allows plaintext HTTP on the loopback interface over the existing TLS port, while external clients still require HTTPS.
plugins.author: lzt404

zh-CN.description: 在现有 TLS 端口上放行本机回环的明文 HTTP 请求，外部客户端仍强制使用 HTTPS。

plugins.name: AIStudio2API
plugins.description: CLIProxyAPI native C ABI plugin that exposes Google AI Studio Playground and Build channels as OpenAI, Responses, Claude and Gemini APIs, with an in-process SpiderMonkey BotGuard WAA engine and multi-account cooldown-aware scheduling.
plugins.author: jianli9158

zh-CN.description: 将 Google AI Studio 的 Playground 与 Build 双通道以 OpenAI / Responses / Claude / Gemini 四种协议对外提供，内置进程中 SpiderMonkey BotGuard WAA 签名引擎，支持多账号权益分级与冷却调度，并可在控制台一键拉起本机 Chrome 完成 OAuth 登录。
